summary_en: The study tests revumenib, also called SNDX-5613, in people with relapsed or refractory acute leukemia, including leukemias with a KMT2A gene rearrangement or an NPM1 mutation. Revumenib is taken by mouth, and the dosing schedule and treatment length are not stated. Phase 1 finds the maximum tolerated dose and recommended Phase 2 dose, and Phase 2 measures efficacy, short- and long-term safety, and tolerability.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa revumenib, también llamado SNDX-5613, en personas con leucemia aguda recidivante o refractaria, incluidas las leucemias con reordenamiento del gen KMT2A o mutación de NPM1. Revumenib se toma por vía oral, y el esquema de dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican en el registro. La fase 1 determinará la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para la fase 2, y la fase 2 medirá la eficacia, la seguridad a corto y largo plazo y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Active acute leukemia with at least 5% bone marrow blasts, or blasts back in the blood.
ECOG performance status 0-2, or Karnofsky/Lansky score of 50 or higher.
Side effects from earlier treatment resolved to grade 1 or lower before enrollment.
White blood cell count below 25,000 per microliter at enrollment.
not_for: Diagnosis of active acute promyelocytic leukemia.
Detectable HIV viral load within the previous 6 months, or hepatitis B or C.
Heart events within 6 months, or QTc above 450 milliseconds.
